job.rawJd: This is a W-2 contract role through Magnit for Airbnb, fully remote in the United States only, with no corp-to-corp option. Airbnb's Trust & Safety team includes engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and operations leaders who build machine-learning risk detection, defenses against risky actors, and tools for investigators while defining standards and policies. The Product Manager will focus on Safety and reducing incidents such as interpersonal harm and illegal activities. Responsibilities include creating product and platform vision and strategy; leading cross-functional groups across engineering, data science, design, operations, and policy; maintaining the backlog and roadmap; prioritizing solutions by business value and customer impact; defining measurable goals and OKRs; building alignment across product and executive teams; anticipating bottlenecks and balancing business, customer, technical, and operational constraints; presenting roadmaps and status to leadership; evaluating buy, build, or partner opportunities with data and users at the forefront; and developing short-term plans aligned with long-term platform capabilities. Expertise requested includes 5+ years of product management experience; prior product, operations, or engineering experience in trust, safety, risk, or fraud; outstanding communication with global executive, product, and technical audiences; strong analytical and problem-solving skills; experience building machine-learning products or technical product management; design and hypothesis-driven product development; entrepreneurial drive; global collaboration and influence; and experience leading through ambiguity and high-stakes tradeoffs. Location is remote in the United States only. Pay range is $78-$91 per hour with medical, dental, vision, and 401K benefits.
